title: PCGRL for Complex Platformers: Synthesizing Playable and Diverse Levels via Inflated Envelopes and Forward Curricula
abstract: arXiv:2611.22250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Procedural Content Generation via Reinforcement Learning (PCGRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for automated game development. However, existing PCGRL frameworks still suffer from severe exploration bottlenecks and scaling limitations when faced with long-sequence generation tasks governed by strict rigid-body rules and non-linear kinematic boundaries (e.g., platformer constraints). Consequently, traditional approaches frequently fail to maintain reliable level solvability on large-scale canvases. To address these challenges, we present a physics-aware, curriculum-guided PCGRL framework. First, we construct an "Inflated Volume Envelope" mechanism, which provides a physics-constrained representation that incorporates continuous kinematic feasibility into the discrete state space of the MDP. translated_title: 面向复杂平台跳跃游戏的PCGRL：通过膨胀包络与前向课程合成可玩且多样化的关卡
translated_abstract: 通过强化学习进行程序化内容生成（PCGRL）已成为自动化游戏开发中一种有前景的范式。然而，现有的PCGRL框架在面对由严格刚体规则和非线性运动学边界（如平台跳跃约束）所支配的长序列生成任务时，仍然存在严重的探索瓶颈和扩展性限制。因此，传统方法经常无法在大规模画布上保持可靠的关卡可解性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个物理感知、课程引导的PCGRL框架。首先，我们构建了一个“膨胀体积包络”机制，它提供了一种物理约束的表示方法，将连续运动学可行性融入马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的离散状态空间中。其次，为了缓解由极长决策序列引起的稀疏奖励挑战，我们引入了中间状态转移反馈（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出一个物理感知、课程引导的PCGRL框架，通过“膨胀体积包络”机制将连续运动学可行性融入离散状态空间，并引入中间状态转移反馈来缓解稀疏奖励问题，从而在复杂平台跳跃游戏的大规模关卡生成中保证关卡的可玩性与多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-aware, curriculum-guided PCGRL framework that incorporates continuous kinematic feasibility into the discrete MDP state space via an Inflated Volume Envelope mechanism and mitigates sparse rewards through intermediate state-transition feedback, enabling reliable playable and diverse large-scale platformer level generation.
